items.title: Scrap junk to produce Acid
items.detail: Craft Bulk Acid at a Tinker's Workbench

items.title: Craft or Scrap Armor
items.detail: Craft basic armor or scrap found pieces at any armor workbench

items.title: Craft or Scrap a Ranged Weapon
items.detail: Craft a basic ranged weapon or scrap one at a weapons workbench

items.title: Gain XP
items.detail: Complete kills, events, and quests or grind West Tek

items.title: Kill a Canine
items.detail: Fast travel to Autumn Acre Cabin for reliable spawn of up to 6 Canines

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation while on a Team!
items.detail: Join a team and enter Daily Ops; Phantoms are masked cultists from the Slasher event

items.title: Build a Decoration in a Shelter
items.detail: Access your C.A.M.P. shelter, use build menu, select Decorations category

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any water source; Fisherman's Rest in The Mire is a reliable location

items.title: Collect RadAway or Rad-X
items.detail: Collect from world loot or craft diluted forms at a chemistry station

items.title: Collect Soap
items.detail: Find soap in showers at Whitespring Resort or collect from a Whitespring Robo Butler Collectron

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Take a Board Game from a Games Cupboard at your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Eat a Vegetable
items.detail: Harvest Tato, Corn, or Razorgrain from your C.A.M.P. or Billings Homestead, then eat one

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Enter Daily Ops and kill Phantoms; you do not need to finish the operation

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Find an active Infestation on the map and kill Phantoms in the hotspot

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Earn the daily Gold Star on three separate days during the week

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: All rewards from Mutated Party Packages are available during this weekly event.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: A seasonal building competition for players to showcase their C.A.M.P. creations.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: A Halloween-themed seasonal event with special rewards.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: A Halloween seasonal event featuring spooky Scorched enemies and unique rewards.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Weekend event with increased chances of catching seasonal fish.
